div.h3: Both halves must be in place

ul.li: MaaSAuthPolicy decides who may call. Without one, every request is denied.
MaaSSubscription decides how many tokens. Without one there is no quota to check, and the model never reaches phase=Ready.

div.p: Header stripping (step 2) needs Kuadrant 1.4.2+ / RHCL 1.3+. On older versions the caller's token is forwarded to the model pod, where a compromised backend could harvest it.
